globalProperty.value: SELECT sub.uuid, sub.identifier, sub.givenName, sub.middleName, sub.familyName, sub.phoneNumber, sub.alternatePhoneNumber, sub.gender, sub.age, sub.date_created FROM ( SELECT p.uuid, pi.identifier, pn.given_name AS givenName, pn.middle_name AS middleName, pn.family_name AS familyName, MAX(CASE WHEN pa_type.name = 'phoneNumber' THEN pa.value ELSE NULL END) AS phoneNumber, MAX(CASE WHEN pa_type.name = 'alternatePhoneNumber' THEN pa.value ELSE NULL END) AS alternatePhoneNumber, p.gender AS gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birthdate, CURDATE()) AS age, p.date_created, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.date_created DESC) AS row_num FROM person p JOIN person_name pn ON pn.person_id = p.person_id AND pn.preferred = 1 AND pn.voided = 0 JOIN patient_identifier pi ON pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.preferred = 1 AND pi.voided = 0 JOIN patient_identifier_type pit ON pi.identifier_type = pit.patient_identifier_type_id JOIN global_property gp ON gp.property = 'bahmni.primaryIdentifierType' AND gp.property_value = pit.uuid JOIN location l ON l.uuid = ${identifiersourcelocation} LEFT JOIN location_attribute_type lat ON lat.name = 'IdentifierSourceName' LEFT JOIN location_attribute la ON la.location_id = l.location_id AND la.attribute_type_id = lat.location_attribute_type_id AND la.voided = 0 LEFT JOIN person_attribute pa ON pa.person_id = p.person_id AND pa.voided = 0 LEFT JOIN person_attribute_type pa_type ON pa_type.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id AND pa_type.name IN ('phoneNumber', 'alternatePhoneNumber') WHERE p.voided = 0 AND (la.value_reference IS NULL OR pi.identifier LIKE CONCAT(la.value_reference, '%')) AND ( (${name} is not null and ${name} != '' ) AND (pn.given_name LIKE CONCAT('%', ${name}, '%') OR pn.middle_name LIKE CONCAT('%', ${name}, '%') OR pn.family_name LIKE CONCAT('%', ${name}, '%')) ) GROUP BY p.uuid, pi.identifier, pn.given_name, pn.middle_name, pn.family_name, p.gender, p.birthdate, p.date_created ) AS sub;
